summary: Wow is an open hand shaking loosely at the wrist in front of you, with a wide-eyed face. The face does most of the work.
steps: Hold a relaxed open hand in front of you, palm facing in.
Shake it loosely at the wrist a few times.
Open your eyes wide and let your mouth form 'wow.'
mistakes: Stiff fingers. The hand is floppy, not a flat B.
